title: Receptor
description: Schema for Receptor Ascriptions — input endpoint of a Mechanism. Defines the owning Mechanism and the data Archetype that types the input payload. DM input = DM output (1:1). Extensible — tenant-defined archetypes MAY extend Receptor via a top-level $ref to add domain-specific port vocabulary while inheriting the base port schema.

mechanism.description: ID reference to the owning Mechanism. A Receptor cannot exist without a Mechanism.

archetype.description: Archetype URI of the exact data Archetype version that types the Receptor's input payload. The processor resolves it to the exact Archetype Ascription FK. To change the data Archetype family, author a new Definition.
